subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Cliffhanger That Changed Television
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Cliffhanger That Changed Television usable.

hook.text: When Dallas ended its 1979 season with JR Ewing being shot, America spent an entire summer asking who did it.

buildup.text: Before Dallas, season finales wrapped up storylines neatly.

discovery.text: The cliffhanger exploits a psychological principle: the Zeigarnik effect.

climax.text: The cliffhanger was television's most effective retention tool.

punchline.text: The best TV endings are the ones that refuse to end.

quiz.question: What psychological principle makes cliffhangers so effective?
options: The Zeigarnik effect—unfinished stories occupy our minds more than completed ones
